reviews.review_description: Hard to play camera is inside avatar. Hard to see.

developer_response.body:
Hi Stortz, thank you for the feedback — you were right, and it's fixed.

The avatar's head no longer blocks the view, and you can now adjust the
camera yourself in Settings: a "camera distance" slider that moves the
view forward, plus an option to hide your body completely. Both settings
are remembered between sessions.

Please update to the latest version and give it another try. If anything
still feels off, reply here and I'll take care of it. Thanks for taking
the time to report it!
